property_summary: For any caller address x and newKeeper address k, only the contract owner (the deployer) can successfully change keeper via setKeeper in the correct contract; the mutant that removes the onlyOwner check allows non-owners to change keeper, so there exist caller/newKeeper pairs where keeper after the call differs between reference and mutant.
change_summary: Remove owner check in onlyOwner modifier so setKeeper can be called by anyone, potentially changing keeper to caller-provided value instead of owner-controlled value.
